overview.intent: Add a multi-language greet API, document it, and keep a large helper type reviewable as one unit.
changes: Introduce a TypeScript greet helper beside the Rust library.
Make Python scaling take an explicit factor.
Rewrite the guide as Markdown the reviewer can read as a document.
Keep the oversized Big type together with an explicit reason.

illustration.after: Rust + TypeScript + Python share greet; docs in Markdown

concepts: The same greet contract is mirrored in TypeScript for the web surface.
Python scaling now takes an explicit factor instead of a hidden default.

chunks.title: TypeScript `greet` helper
chunks.summary: A new module exports `greet` for the web surface; the added code is the whole story.

context.definition: A thin TypeScript mirror of the Rust greet helper.
context.relation: Reviewers see the same greeting contract outside Rust.

content.markdown: The new TypeScript module is pure addition, so show it as added code.

chunks.title: Python `scale` takes a factor
chunks.summary: `scale(x)` becomes `scale(x, factor=2)`; the diff shows the old signature disappearing.

context.after: def scale(x, factor=2): return x * factor
context.reason: Callers may choose a factor without a second helper.

chunks.title: Guide as a document
chunks.summary: The Markdown guide is meant to be read as prose, not as a raw diff.

content.markdown: Rendered Markdown keeps the fence boundaries visible.

chunks.title: Notes summarized
chunks.summary: A trivial text tweak is summarized rather than shown line by line.

content.markdown: Summary-only presentation for generated or uninteresting text.

chunks.title: Rust greet punctuation
chunks.summary: The library module documentation and greet punctuation change first.

content.markdown: Module docs and greet gain an exclamation point.

chunks.title: Rust arithmetic helpers
chunks.summary: Saturating add and a new `multiply` complete the library edits.

content.markdown: The rest of the hunk covers add and multiply.

chunks.title: Oversized Big type
chunks.summary: Big is one type with many step methods; it stays one chunk with an oversized reason.
chunks.oversized_reason: A single type with its step methods must stay together.

content.markdown: The whole file is one semantic unit.
